assessments.rationale: Core innovation has real revenue and backlog, but Neutron development and the Iridium acquisition are capital intensive. Financial-survival analysis should determine whether this becomes structural dependence.

June liquidity was about $2.39B with minimal Rocket Lab debt, management stated at least 12 months of operating/capex liquidity, and the September equity raise was designated to fund an acquisition rather than ordinary survival.

non_owner_escalations.rationale: Core innovation has real revenue and backlog, but Neutron development and the Iridium acquisition are capital intensive. Financial-survival analysis should determine whether this becomes structural dependence.

assessments.rationale: Outstanding common shares rose about 10% from Dec. 31, 2025 to June 30, 2026, and another 29.3M ATM shares were issued by Sep. 15. Whether this is a one-time acquisition-financing episode or a persistent multi-year pattern remains unresolved.

basis.direction: 27개 전부 gpt-5.6-sol >= Claude Opus 5. 노이즈가 아니라 계통 편향.
basis.caveat: 표본은 종목 1개다. 다른 종목의 쌍 실행이 쌓이면 base_offset을 재추정해야 한다. harness.py calibrate로 측정한다.
